summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about true friendship; Bhishma lists traits of people to avoid and virtues of those worthy of alliance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits before the arrow‑bed of Bhishma and respectfully asks his grandsire about the nature of true friends.
Bhishma, lying upon a bed of arrows, raises his hand while instructing gathered princes on the many vices that make a man unfit for friendship.
